import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Piece from './Piece.vue';
import { FURNITURE } from './furniture';

const pieces = ref(FURNITURE.map((piece) => ({ ...piece })));
const inRoom = computed(() => pieces.value.filter((piece) => piece.place === 'room'));
const inStorage = computed(() => pieces.value.filter((piece) => piece.place === 'storage'));
const find = (id: Key) => pieces.value.find((piece) => piece.id === id);
const clamp = (value: number, max: number) => Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(value), 0), max);

const room = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('room');
const { isOver: overRoom } = makeDroppable(room, {
  id: 'room',
  // `position` is where the dragged box's top-left corner is in the room: the `left` and
  // `top` that put the piece where it was let go. Clamped here to stay inside the walls.
  onDrop: ({ active, position }) => {
    const piece = find(active.id);
    if (!piece || !position || !room.value) return;
    piece.x = clamp(position.x, room.value.clientWidth - piece.width);
    piece.y = clamp(position.y, room.value.clientHeight - piece.height);
    piece.place = 'room';
  },
});

const storage = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('storage');
const { isOver: overStorage } = makeDroppable(storage, {
  id: 'storage',
  onDrop: ({ active }) => {
    const piece = find(active.id);
    if (piece) piece.place = 'storage';
  },
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, makeSortableList, useDnD, type DnDEvent } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import NoticeRow from './NoticeRow.vue';
import { NOTICES, type Notice } from './notices';

const notices = ref<Notice[]>([...NOTICES]);
const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, { items: notices });

const bins = reactive({ done: [] as Notice[], deleted: [] as Notice[] });
/** The last triage, for Undo. */
const last = ref<{ bin: keyof typeof bins; moved: Notice[]; index: number } | null>(null);

// A drag that starts in a sortable list carries `e.source`: `remove()` takes the dragged
// items out of that list. The zone keeps them.
const triage = (bin: keyof typeof bins) => (e: DnDEvent) => {
  const moved = e.active.items.map((entry) => entry.item as Notice);
  last.value = { bin, moved, index: notices.value.findIndex((notice) => notice.id === moved[0]?.id) };
  bins[bin].push(...moved);
  e.source?.remove();
};

const doneZone = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('doneZone');
const trashZone = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('trashZone');
const { isOver: overDone } = makeDroppable(doneZone, { id: 'done', onDrop: triage('done') });
const { isOver: overTrash } = makeDroppable(trashZone, { id: 'trash', onDrop: triage('deleted') });

const undo = () => {
  if (!last.value) return;
  const { bin, moved, index } = last.value;
  bins[bin] = bins[bin].filter((notice) => !moved.some((item) => item.id === notice.id));
  notices.value.splice(index, 0, ...moved);
  last.value = null;
};

const { active } = useDnD();
</script>

import { makeDroppable, makeSortableItem, makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import LinkRow from './LinkRow.vue';
import type { Folder, Link } from './bookmarks';

const props = defineProps<{ folder: Folder }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ add: [links: Link[]] }>();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.folder, type: 'folder' });

// The same element takes links. While the list sorts, only the middle of the row counts:
// a link let go there goes into the folder; near its edges the list sorts as usual. It
// refuses folders, so a folder dragged over it just sorts.
const { isOver } = makeDroppable(el, {
  accept: 'link',
  onDrop: (e) => {
    emit('add', e.active.items.map((entry) => entry.item as Link));
    e.source?.remove(); // and out of the list they came from
  },
});

// Open, the folder's links are a list of the same group: they sort, and drag back out.
// It takes links only: a folder never goes into a folder.
const open = ref(false);
const inner = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('inner');
const { items: links } = makeSortableList(inner, {
  items: toRef(props.folder, 'links'),
  group: { name: 'bookmarks', put: ({ types }) => types.every((type) => type === 'link') },
});

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import AgendaRow from './AgendaRow.vue';

type Block = { title: string; minutes: number; color: string };
type Entry = Block & { id: string };

const agenda = ref<Entry[]>([
  { id: 'standup', title: 'Standup', minutes: 15, color: '#3b82f6' },
  { id: 'deep-work', title: 'Focus', minutes: 90, color: '#42b883' },
  { id: 'lunch', title: 'Lunch', minutes: 60, color: '#f59e0b' },
]);

let created = 0;
const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// A plain draggable comes in through `createItem`: the entry it returns sits in the draft
// while the block is over the agenda, and becomes real on drop.
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, {
  items: agenda,
  createItem: (active) => ({ ...(active.data as Block), id: `entry-${++created}` }),
});

// Times from 9:00, computed on the draft: they follow the drag.
const DAY_START = 9 * 60;
const clock = (minutes: number) => `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const times = computed(() => {
  let at = DAY_START;
  return items.value.map((entry) => {
    const start = at;
    at += entry.minutes;
    return { start: clock(start), end: clock(at) };
  });
});
const remove = (id: string) => (agenda.value = agenda.value.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

interface Attachment {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
}

const files = ref<Attachment[]>([{ id: 0, name: 'brief.pdf', size: 182_000 }]);
/** What the last drop left out: extensions are only known at the drop. */
const skipped = ref(0);
let made = 0;

const add = (taken: File[], all = taken.length) => {
  files.value.push(...taken.map((file) => ({ id: ++made, name: file.name, size: file.size })));
  skipped.value = all - taken.length;
};

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const { isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(el, {
  external: { files: '.pdf, .md, .txt, image/*' },
  // `files` has those it takes; `fileTypes` counts everything that was dropped.
  onDrop: (e) => add([...e.external!.files], e.external!.fileTypes.length),
});

const pick = (event: Event) => {
  const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
  add([...(input.files ?? [])]);
  input.value = '';
};

const size = (bytes: number) => (bytes < 1_000_000 ? `${Math.round(bytes / 1000)} KB` : `${(bytes / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)} MB`);
</script>

});

};
